answer: Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 117 epochs of grading, and every prism settlement recomputes the shale schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 117 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
